Remark
[Euclidean rigidity from asymptotic volume ratio]

Source: petersen:page-0324 ↗ lem:pet-ch7-relative-volume-comparison 1. ch7:7.5.10Show that a complete manifold $(M,g)$ with $\Ric \ge 0$ and $\lim _{r\to \infty }\vol B(p,r)/(\omega _nr^n)=1$ for some $p\in M$ must be isometric to Euclidean space.
